_note: How each pose family of the part rigs (rigs.json and the other rig files: a rig's "family") behaves in src/rig/rig_renderer.gd, beside its pose code (src/rig/rig_poses.gd). A family not listed here takes "default"; a key a family leaves out takes default's. attacks: the clip an attack plays and its windows [clip, end of windup, end of active] in clip progress (0..1): "variants" by the rig's variant first, then "kinds" by the attack's kind, else "default"; "pose_table": "drake" takes the clip and windows from RigPoses.DRAKE_KINDS / DRAKE_WINDOWS (default when the kind has none). crumble: when it dies nothing is left to draw (its parts fell as debris). material: the gore material of a rig without its own (feedback, talent_fx). chips: the colours cut parts spray when the rig has no material palette. dying_shadow: false drops the shadow while it dies. rise_fade: false keeps a summoned figure opaque while it rises (it climbs out of the pool). flight_shadow: [height px, most]: the shadow shrinks by up to `most` as the pose lifts it `height` px. death: what its death does, in this order: ragdoll (every part and item flies off with the blow, times this impulse factor) or, with tear_ragdoll, only a tearing blow (against a wall or of the huge tier) ragdolls and any other sheds; shed: [{ids (part ids, or "items" for every held item), impulse (factor), hide (true: the falling body no longer draws them), skip_gone (true: parts the rig lacks or already lost are left alone)}]; bursts: [{at (px above the feet), color (hex) or palette (a key of the rig material's palette, e.g. "burst"; fallback_material when the rig has none), count, speed px/s, when / unless (a snapshot flag: summoned, exploded)}]; flashes: [{at, r, max (s), color, material (only for that rig material)}]. registered: companion families added through register_family (src/vfx/companion_rigs.gd) crumble and ragdoll with this impulse factor.
